operations.evidence: The current contract, canonical HEAD 9e505bc119690fa75fb8a9ad17b90d6f40dd0300, UNCLAIMED owner, sequence 34 checkpoint, pickup_requested queue and open H-to-F blocker were verified before writes.
A 15-minute lease was claimed only for official source and line-by-line website evidence; runner and business writes remained disabled.
The current Crime in England and Wales QMI was pinned to its 2 April 2026 revision.
CSEW and police recorded crime were retained as complementary but non-equivalent sources with distinct coverage and limitations.
Police recorded crime was restricted to notifiable offences reported to and recorded by police; non-notifiable offences and ASB were not silently included.
The QMI's approximate 42 percent reporting share for CSEW-comparable crime was retained as national survey context and not parcel confidence.
Transfers, cancellations, category changes and revised monthly totals were treated as live administrative revisions requiring an edition-pinned snapshot.
The ONS action plan was classified as a response to OSR recommendations and not as proof that all improvements are complete.
The April 2002 NCRS change and main post-March-2003 trend boundary were preserved for recorded-crime comparisons.
Real-time force recording, investigation updates, force checks, Home Office validation and ONS publication checks were recorded as separate QA stages.
The 9 June 2026 crime methodology index was used to select current documents and reject superseded guidance as controlling evidence.
The force-list endpoint excludes British Transport Police; list absence was not interpreted as absence from all crime records.
Force identifiers were retained as API routing keys rather than statistical or parcel geography identifiers.
Neighbourhood IDs were confirmed as force-specific and potentially reused by other forces, so force plus neighbourhood is required as a compound key.
Operational police neighbourhoods were not substituted for official ONS LSOA geography.
The neighbourhood centre point may not be the exact centre and was not treated as the boundary or target parcel location.
The API population field was not used instead of an edition-pinned ONS LSOA population denominator.
Neighbourhood boundary coordinate arrays were classified as operational police geometry and not official LSOA boundaries.
Valid category identifiers and labels were pinned to the requested dataset month.
The all-crime category includes crime and anti-social behaviour and was not treated as a homogeneous notifiable-crime measure.
Latitude and longitude queries were confirmed to resolve to the nearest predefined map location rather than the exact supplied point.
Returned coordinates and street names remain approximate and cannot prove an incident occurred on a target parcel.
outcome_status was retained as the latest recorded outcome and not substituted for complete outcome history.
Custom areas exceeding 10,000 outcomes return HTTP 503 and require bounded subdivision or explicit failure evidence.
The outcomes endpoint does not provide Police Service of Northern Ireland outcomes; geographic coverage was kept explicit.
NSUL was verified to assign current addresses to Output Areas using UPRN and point-in-polygon methodology.
Direct UPRN-to-OA assignment was kept distinct from OA-to-higher-geography best-fit allocation using Census population.
NSUL's National Statistics producer and AddressBase dependencies were recorded; it was not claimed as executed runtime evidence.
Stop-and-search locations are approximate and cannot be attributed to exact parcels.
Stop-and-search records were treated as police-activity context rather than crime incidence or safety probability.
The current Home Office outcome release was pinned to 23 July 2026 and the financial year ending March 2026.
PFA, CSP, offence, outcomes, alternate outcomes, transferred or cancelled and supplementary products were separated and tied to their reference tables.
Outcome cohorts linked to offences recorded in a quarter were recognised as incomplete at first publication because investigations may remain open.

All 12 candidates remain unjoined at confidence zero; source rows 107-122 and operation rows 361-394 were published without a second runner, task, candidate value, business row, database write, migration or deployment.
